text: I am writing to request your support in prohibiting stopping on the west side of Redpath Ave immediately south of Eglinton Ave East, directly abutting the driveway (located on the east side) of the condo at 123 Eglinton Ave East. The Condo Board and area residents contacted my office to request this prohibition because the current “No Standing” signs are difficult to enforce as there have been several occasions where commercial vehicles and trucks stop to load and unload, creating absolute gridlock on Redpath Ave. This situation also creates sightline issues for residents exiting the driveway.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing standing prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Redpath Avenue, between Soudan Avenue and Eglinton Avenue East, to be in effect between Soudan Avenue and a point 39 metres south of Eglinton Avenue East. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of Redpath Avenue, between a point 39 metres south of Eglinton Avenue East and Eglinton Avenue East.
